finding.description: Configuration and database backups are downloadable.

recommendation.goal: What is the recommended fix for this web security flaw: directory-listing-backups (Configuration and database backups are downloadable. Evidence: index listing wp-config.php.bak and shop-2024-03-01.sql). State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Recommended fix: Remove wp-config.php.bak and shop-2024-03-01.sql from the web-accessible tree and do not store backups in the docroot — store them outside the web root or with denied access. Disable directory listing/indexing for all paths beneath the web root so indexes do not expose backups and config files.

sources.contribution: These files may be created when editing application files, creating on-the-fly backup copies, or leaving old or unreferenced files in the web tree
An attacker can use Brute Force techniques to search for unlinked contents in the domain directory, such as temporary directories, files, old backups or configuration files

fix.risk: Any legitimate use of /backup/ URLs will now 404; no journeys use them.
